request.spec:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
People can now name patrons from their row, and each row shows their patrons and backing. All 4 acceptance tests pass under `bin/e2e`.

**How it works on screen:** each person's row has a **Patron** dropdown and an **Add patron** button. The dropdown lists everyone on the sheet except the person themselves, retired people included. Two new columns show:
- `person-patrons`: the patrons' names, sorted, separated by ", ".
- `person-backing`: the patrons' due-totals added up, skipping any that are n/a. It shows 0.00 when there are no patrons.

Backing is worked out on screen from the same due-totals the rows show, so it changes with them (for example, it drops when a patron is put on hold).

**Refusals:**
- A person can't pick themselves, because they aren't in the dropdown.
- Naming someone already a patron is refused by the server. The row shows `person-patron-error` and nothing is stored or audited.
- Pressing **Add patron** with nothing chosen also shows the error.
- The error clears as soon as you change the dropdown or take any other action on that row.

**Storage and server:**
- **Table:** a new `person_patron` table (migration `V24__person_patron.sql`), with a database rule against naming the same patron twice. I kept patrons out of the person record so that adding one doesn't count as an edit, which would otherwise make another user's open editor out of date.
- **Endpoints:** `GET /api/sheets/{id}/people/patrons` lists them and `POST /api/sheets/{id}/people/{personId}/patrons` adds one. Both are in `PersonController`, and the server logic is in `PersonService.addPatron`.
- **Audit:** a successful add writes `PATRON_ADDED sheet=<id> by=<user> name=<name> patron=<patron name>`.

**Front end:** the changes are in `people.ts` and `people.service.ts`. Patrons are re-read from the store whenever the sheet is loaded.
